To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
OFDM WDM systems are a good solution for long haul transmission and it can be used to enhance the performance of the optical communication system.
the OFDM system with direct detection can achieve a data rate of up to 40Gbits/s, and the OFDM system can achieve data rates of 50Gbits/s and beyond with coherent detection.
the system is capable to transmit 100Gbits/ s over a single mode optical fiber with 80km reach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance analysis of OFDM system with WDM for long haul applications.
the performance analysis of OFDM systems for high-speed optical fiber communication.
the implementation of high data rate optical communication systems based on OFDM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system performance is improved by increasing the data rate, the Q factor and the eye opening are increasing, while the BER is decreasing.
OFDM has the potential for being a very promising technique for future high speed transmission.
, OFDM is a promising technology to achieve high capacity and data rates in long haul optical communication systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the OFDM Wavelength Division Multiplexer is a promising solution to increase the data rate of the optical fiber communication.
the OFDM WDMA system with coherent detection is the most efficient system in terms of spectral efficiency, the highest data rate, and the highest Q factor.
the simulation results of the system show that the OFDM system is able to achieve a very high data rate of 100Gbits with QAM modulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the OFDM WDMA system with coherent detection has a better performance than the OFDM system with direct detection.
the OFDM system is capable of transmitting high speed data with low BER.
OFDM is a suitable modulation technique for high speed optical communication systems.
